description: This file defines a React functional component 'ExecutionCard' which displays information about an execution, including status, timestamps, workflow details, and optional actions. It uses imported UI components such as Badge, StatusBadge, Button, Card, and CardContent, and types from external type definitions.

methods.name: ExecutionCard
methods.description: React functional component rendering execution details in either compact or detailed view, with helpers for formatting durations, timestamps, and sizes.

methods.name: getStatusVariant
methods.description: Determines the status badge variant based on execution status string.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Converts duration in milliseconds to a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats timestamps into relative or absolute date strings.

methods.name: formatSize
methods.description: Formats byte sizes into human-readable units.
